name: Shale oil and gas multi-stage horizontal development
aliases: Shale oil and gas multi-stage horizontal development
principle: Horizontal wells with laterals of 1,500 to 10,000 ft are fractured in 30 or more stages to produce tight oil and shale gas. EIA data cited by Wikipedia put US tight oil at 7.23 million b/d in 2021, about 64% of US crude.

suppliers.name: Operators
suppliers.product: Permian, Bakken, Eagle Ford and others

gaps.item: well cost and decline rate with year
gaps.reason: Not given; the collected EIA document (AEO2026 Electricity Market Module assumptions, April 2026) has no shale well-cost or decline-rate data (it covers power-plant technology costs only). Web-checked 2026-10-28: open academic sources give Sichuan-basin D&C at USD 10.4-11.7 m/well (mid-2015) and scattered Marcellus averages, but no current authoritative US well-cost series in open form; EIA discontinued the DPR well-cost content.
